headline: Chile Inflation Reaches 0.5% in October, Cementing December Rate Hike Bets
summary: Chile's consumer price index rose 0.5% in October, matching forecasts but confirming year-end inflation could close near 5%, cementing market expectations of a December interest rate hike by the central bank.
why: Banco Central de Chile's policy path influences Latin American interest rate differentials and sovereign bond pricing.
